scenes.say: Dark roast isn't stronger coffee. So what does it change?
Stronger than light roast? False. By weight, the caffeine is about the same.
Strong can mean bold flavor or more caffeine. Dark wins only the first.
Roasting changes taste: lighter is brighter, darker is bolder.
Roasting puffs beans up, so a dark roast scoop weighs less. Weigh in grams.
So choose by taste, not by color. Want bolder? Go darker.
Dark roast is bolder, not stronger. Share this with a dark roast fan.
